req.title: Reject squadNumber lookup for non-numeric value
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer segment.
triggers: reject squadnumber lookup for non-numeric value

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-037 requires HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer path segment. FastAPI enforces this via Pydantic/path parameter type coercion (squad_number: int). The violation was: test[4] had kind=negative but heuristic=EP. A negative test should use heuristic=NEG (invalid equivalence class) not EP (which is for valid partitions). Fix: change test[4] (alphanumeric mixed) from heuristic=EP to heuristic=NEG, since mixed alphanumeric is an invalid input class. All other tests are preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
Squad number 10 (Lionel Messi) exists in the database
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid integer path segment
trace: R-PLAYER-037: valid integer must NOT trigger 422; confirms the 422 path is not always taken (catches boolean-negation mutations on the validation branch)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_alphanumeric_mixed_returns_422
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
FastAPI path parameter squad_number is typed as int
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/10abc with a mixed alphanumeric non-integer path segment
expected: Response body contains a 'detail' key with at least one entry
trace: R-PLAYER-037: mixed alphanumeric is a distinct invalid equivalence class from pure alpha or pure numeric; catches mutations that only check for purely alpha strings
tests.executable:

assert r.status_code == 422

assert 'detail' in body

assert len(body['detail']) >= 1

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_boundary_squad_1_returns_200
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
Squad number 1 (Franco Armani) exists in the database
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/1 with the minimum valid integer squad number present in the dataset
trace: R-PLAYER-037: boundary — squad number 1 is the lowest in the dataset; confirms integer '1' is accepted (not 422); catches mutations that widen the 422 condition to include small integers
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/1')
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
assert body['lastName'] == 'Armani'

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_negative_integer_returns_404_not_422
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
No player with a negative squad number exists
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/-1 with a negative integer path segment
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found (negative integer is a valid int type but no such player exists)
Must NOT return HTTP 422 (negative integers are still integers)
trace: R-PLAYER-037: boundary — '-1' is syntactically an integer so FastAPI should NOT return 422; it should return 404 because no player has squad_number=-1; catches mutations that treat negative numbers as non-integer
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/-1')
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 422
